title: Answers that count
description: Version 1.0, published by lecture-archive (adopted 29 October 2026, ADR-0016) from review-assistance's draft. Written by the review app with every answers export: for each stop of one package, the record that counts, if any. Only the app decides this (agreed 29 October 2026); lecture-archive checks the list and applies it, and never works it out for itself. Rules this schema cannot express are listed in contracts/review/README.md in lecture-archive.

package.description: The package whose stops this list covers.

answers.description: The answers export this list goes with. Each export holds every record for the lecture so far, so the pair stands on its own.

app_revision.description: Git commit of the review app build that decided the list.

stops.description: Every stop in the package, once each, in the package's order. Nothing is left out.

state.description: open: no answer yet. answered: a reviewer's answer counts. checked: a spot check agreed with the answer, or corrected it. needs-decision: waiting for the supervisor (can't tell, I don't know this language, or a flag), or for Mukul (escalated). settled: the supervisor or Mukul settled it.

record.description: The id of the record that counts, or null while the stop is open or needs a decision. lecture-archive reads the record's own answer to see what to apply. When a republished package keeps a stop's id, earlier answers carry over (agreed 29 October 2026), so this may be a record given on an earlier version of the lecture's package; the record's own package fields say which.
